default/32469.htm.text: Vice Hierarch Eindburgh: The Kamael have had the same Elders for ages. Except for me... Why am I the exception? Ah! I am Kekropus' opposite number. I can do the one thing that he cannot. What is that, you ask? Make trouble! Ha!

Q00061_LawEnforcement/32469-01.html.text: Vice Hierarch Eindburgh: %name%, are you the next Judicator? Do you wish to be an executor of Kamael law?

Q00061_LawEnforcement/32469-02.html.text: Vice Hierarch Eindburgh: I see -- Kekropus simply told you the history and left it to me to tell you the meaning of your existence... Very well, then. links.text: "I have the Seeds of Chaos in my hand."

Q00061_LawEnforcement/32469-03.html.text: Vice Hierarch Eindburgh: I thought so. Since the Seeds of Chaos contain order out of chaos, only one child in a generation is born with the power. links.text: Ask about the Seeds of Chaos.

Q00061_LawEnforcement/32469-04.html.text: Vice Hierarch Eindburgh: The Seeds of Chaos were planted by the King of Chaos to enable their recipients to overcome the restrictions imposed on mortals by the gods. This is why the wielders of Enuma Elish can still live, despite being cursed by the gods. If this power is manifested, we Kamael can …

Q00061_LawEnforcement/32469-05.html.text: Vice Hierarch Eindburgh: Kamael Warriors. Perfect soldiers! But even the sharpest sword is useless without a skilled wielder. Q00061_LawEnforcement/32469-07.html.text: Vice Hierarch Eindburgh: Yes. An Inspector searches and judges, but a Judicator is required to make an unexpected leap in judgment. Q00061_LawEnforcement/32469-08.html.text: Vice Hierarch Eindburgh: Then you are not an Inspector, but rather a Judicator capable of judging the laws. Pursue your own path to the future.

Q00061_LawEnforcement/32469-09.html.text: Vice Hierarch Eindburgh: You may wish to refuse, but it may not be possible. A shackle of the creator still remains in you and may unconsciously limit your advancement. But you cannot allow others to make the decision for you. Don't you see?
